snippet.title: The Hollow Path - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the unsettling announcement trailer for The Hollow Path, an upcoming horror VR game that follows the story of a journalist trying to understand the story of five missing people on an island. The Hollow Path will be available on Steam in 2026.
